answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Proof of unique concert ticket stubs. It requires stubs from shows by one buyer over five years, so the voyage of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Because stubs from shows by one buyer over five years, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the shale for an established agent is already paid and proven. A farm doing the maths finds the pigment first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
